name: page-goblin-sync
description: The sync server of Page Goblin: a Cloudflare Worker with D1 and R2.

SETUP_CODE.description: A secret of 16 or more characters. You type it in Page Goblin one time, to connect the app to this server. Make one with `openssl rand -hex 16` and keep it in your password manager.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: The addresses of the app that may use this server, separated by commas. Keep `https://poltak.github.io` to use the public app.
